tools.name: create_trade_account
tools.description: Start here, once per business. Creates the trade's invoice book and returns an API key to send as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" on every other call. Test mode: free, nothing is charged. The same identity (company number) can later sign the trade into Nero Work without a new sign up.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The trade's account, settings and Nero identity.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Change how job references are read and how bills are entered in Xero.

tools.name: add_supplier_invoices
tools.description: Add supplier invoices to the book: raw emails with PDF attachments, PDFs (text or scanned), photos, or pasted text, up to 25 per call. Each is read, checked against its own printed total, given its job reference, kept with its original, and checked for price changes against earlier invoices from the

tools.name: month_summary
tools.description: The month at a glance: one draft bill per supplier with a line per job (net, VAT and which invoices), invoices held back to check, lines with no job reference, and price changes with the extra cost they caused. Includes the exact Xero payloads. Sends nothing.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Every invoice in the book for a month, with its lines, status and any problems.

tools.name: price_alerts
tools.description: Price changes on the same product code from the same supplier this month, in date order, and the extra they cost.

tools.name: get_original
tools.description: A private link to the original email, PDF or scan of one invoice, to show the trade.

tools.name: assign_job_reference
tools.description: Put an invoice (or some of its lines) on a job, when the supplier left the reference off or it was wrong.

tools.name: review_invoice
tools.description: For an invoice held back as needs_check: accept it as read (it then goes on the bill), or remove it (for example to add a corrected copy). Ask the trade first.

tools.name: connect_xero
tools.description: A link for the trade to open and sign in to Xero. Test mode: only a Xero Demo Company can be connected.

tools.name: xero_status
tools.description: Whether Xero is connected, and to which organisation.

tools.name: push_bills_to_xero
tools.description: Put the month's bills into Xero as DRAFT bills, one per supplier, one line per job, with the original invoices attached. Without send: true it is a dry run that shows what would be sent. Running it again updates the same draft (no duplicates). A bill the trade has already approved is never changed;

tools.name: disconnect_xero
tools.description: Forget the Xero connection. Nothing in Xero is changed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_trade_account" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_supplier_invoices, get_original, review_invoice · Private data: create_trade_account, add_supplier_invoices, get_original · Public sink: create_trade_account, get_original, push_bills_to_xero · Destructive: review_invoice, push_bills_to_xero.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_supplier_invoices, get_original, review_invoice · Private data: create_trade_account, add_supplier_invoices, get_original · Public sink: create_trade_account, get_original, push_bills_to_xero · Destructive: review_invoice, push_bills_to_xero

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
